# CANDIDATE: VOLUME_CONFIRMED_BREAKDOWN

**Filed:** 2026-07-08
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** filter_change
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Adding a volume confirmation filter to the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup will reduce false breakdowns by requiring the breakdown bar to have above-average volume, thus avoiding low-volume breakdowns that reverse quickly. This edge exists because J's losing days (5/05, 5/06) featured breakdowns on relatively low volume that failed, while winning days had robust volume confirming the breakdown.

## Mechanism

The BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup's existing context filter "No volume divergence on the breakdown bar" is strengthened by requiring the breakdown bar's volume to be ≥ 1.2× the 20-bar average volume. Entry is blocked if volume < threshold. All other triggers, context filters, and exit logic remain unchanged.
